services.desc: Full Day Rental: 8 a.m. - 4 p.m. Half Day Rental: 10 a.m. - 2 p.m. based on availability. $100.00 deposit per boat. Boats must be checked out before 11 a.m. or the deposit will be forfeited. We do not offer half-day rentals between May 1st - Labor Day. Boat Rental Policies If you were born on or after Jan 1, 1988, a boating safety card is required. For more information, please visit www.boatus.org. Please be aware that boat rentals are subject to an 11-mile boundary North and South of Castaways on the River. View map of authorized areas. Grills are not permitted on boats.
